text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's New Year's Day, and Hishi Akebono is on her way. She said she has something she wants to give me…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's carrying a stack of tiered boxes so high that they almost reach the ceiling.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Sorry I took so long. I got so absorbed in my work that I lost track of time!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's New Year's dishes, mochi soup, and some regular mochi, too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Since it's New Year's, I thought it'd be nice to have a New Year's feast together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And while I was wondering what kind of dishes to make, I figured it'd be best to have everything, so I made everything!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's the very first day of the new year, so I wanted to start it off right!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So, what would you like to eat first?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Some are traditional New Year's dishes, but I made more contemporary ones, too! They're full of meat, so they'll bulk us up for sure!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: The miso soup is still nice and hot, so it'll warm us right up.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: And then there's the mochi… I made all different kinds, so I bet it'll be super fun trying them all!
choice_data_list: Let's bulk up with the New Year's dishes!
Let's warm ourselves up with mochi soup!
Let's enjoy the different mochi together!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, you want to start with the New Year's dishes? Okay!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Don't be too surprised, all right? Here it comes!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ta-dah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that, she lifts the lids off the boxes one by one until about seventy percent of them are open.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soon, the table is crowded with boxes, each one packed with gorgeous New Year's dishes. The servings are unsurprisingly generous.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I wanted us both to be happy and full, so I worked really hard! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: These dishes can keep for quite a while, so it's okay if we don't finish everything today!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's dig in right away! Hold on, I'll go get us some plates. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The volume of food Hishi Akebono has prepared is daunting, but each of the incredible dishes is beyond buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You want to start with the mochi soup? Yay! Ehehe! I'm actually really proud of how buono it turned out today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I made it the way they like it in the Kanto area. It has a soy sauce base with cubes of mochi in there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After her explanation, Hishi Akebono opens the box in her hands…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I see several bowls of soup, each one brimming with neatly arranged ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I cut the carrot pieces into different shapes! They're shaped like bunnies, kitties, stars, and you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yep! ☆ Don't they look just like you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I made them while picturing your smile. I didn't even have to use any photos for reference!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The look-alike carrots are a surprise at first, but the soup's broth and mochi are top-tier and absolutely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh! Nice choice. There are a bunch of different mochi, so you can choose whichever kind you like.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono opens up one of the boxes, revealing a variety of mochi lined up snugly inside.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I made mochi blocks, mochi wrapped in red bean paste, mugwort mochi, mochi with kinako powder, mochi glazed with sweet soy sauce, tricolor mochi, and sakura mochi—although I know it's not quite the season. ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Which one do you want to try? I bet you feel spoilt for choice!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! How about we share them all, and we can both have half of each one?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let me make some tea for us first. I'm just going to borrow your kettle for a sec!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We end up splitting all the mochi between us, and every type is tasty in its own way!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's make this a good year together, Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I really feel like we've made a great start to the new year!
